mapper.select: SELECT id, goal_id, progress_percent, comment, recorded_date, created_at, updated_at FROM goal_progresses WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} ORDER BY recorded_date ASC
SELECT id, goal_id, progress_percent, comment, recorded_date, created_at, updated_at FROM goal_progresses WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} ORDER BY recorded_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal_progresses (id, goal_id, progress_percent, comment, recorded_date) VALUES (#{id}, #{goalId}, #{progressPercent}, #{comment}, #{recordedDate})
